topic: The Ins and Outs of Planning a Student Regional Conference
title: The Ins and Outs of Planning a Student Regional Conference
session_title: The Ins and Outs of Planning a Student Regional Conference
abstract: Planning a regional conference is a daunting task for a student chapter to undertake, but we are here to help. The University of Florida recently held the Southern Regional Conference, and this workshop will cover exactly how to plan your regional conference. We will discuss everything that needs to be done to have a successful conference, starting from the day you win your bid to host the conference up to the execution. Along the way, we will be offering our advice and recommendations on how to make the more complex aspects of the conferences, like the ChemE Car and Jeopardy competitions, run smoothly.
